entities.summary: Sander Terphuis is an Iranian-Dutch lawyer who is half blind. He emigrated from Iran to the Netherlands at the age of eighteen, and began to study law there. Afterwards he entered the world of politics and his name became famous in the Netherlands during a campaign that opposed the criminalization of illegal immigrants.
